baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَتَىٰكَ + حَدِيثُ: the arrival verb governs the report and points it at the second-person addressee.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative foregrounds reception: verbal news crosses into the addressee's present rather than merely existing as stored information.

activation_trace.role: Literal coming and arrival makes the report an incoming communication and the addressee its endpoint.
Speech continually renewed as news supplies what arrives and keeps the event in verbal circulation.

changed_reading.before: A question asking whether the addressee knows a story.
changed_reading.after: A reception event in which a report has traveled into the addressee's present and calls for uptake.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَدِيثُ carries both report-language and the root image of an occurrence coming into being.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling the material a hadith lets a past incident occur anew as present speech; its event-quality is reactivated each time it is delivered.

activation_trace.role: Coming into being after not being gives the report event-like renewal in the moment of telling.
A temporal incident or calamity gives the narrated material pressure beyond neutral information.

changed_reading.before: A static account of a completed past.
changed_reading.after: A past event made newly present through telling, retaining the force of an incident rather than becoming archival data.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The genitive construction حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰ makes Moses the subject of continuing discourse.
baseline_models.mechanism: A person can become what people keep recounting; the named life therefore has a social afterlife as repeatable exemplary talk.

activation_trace.role: Becoming the talk of people turns Moses from a past individual into a circulating example.

changed_reading.before: A report whose interest ends with its named protagonist.
changed_reading.after: The continuing social afterlife of Moses as a case that can be reapplied beyond him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَدِيثُ activates a branch in which repeated address polishes a sword and, by admonition, a heart.
baseline_models.mechanism: The report may be an instrument acting on the receiver: renewed speech removes perceptual dullness rather than only transferring propositions.

activation_trace.role: Polishing a blade or heart through repeated address supplies a transformative function for the report.

changed_reading.after: Admonitory speech that works on and renovates the listener's inward perception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence gives the report a target, process, declared function, and delayed result: an agitated heart is offered purification, the episode is named a lesson, and later the human being remembers.

activation_trace.role: Heart-polishing admonition supplies the focus report's proposed inward operation.
The literal heart identifies the inward site on which the report can act.
Purity and rectitude state the offered process that corresponds to polishing away inward dullness.
Taking admonition by making one condition a lesson for another names the episode's transferable function.
Bringing something back to presence after forgetfulness supplies the report's eventual cognitive effect.

structural_cues: The heart appears before 79:15, purification occurs inside the Moses episode, the episode is explicitly called a lesson, and human remembrance follows later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart, purification, lesson, and remembrance in that order; I infer that the arriving report is the instrument linking those states, while the live alternative is that they are parallel exhortative motifs without a single causal chain.

changed_reading.before: The report can metaphorically polish an unspecified receiver.
changed_reading.after: The report operates as a staged inward intervention, moving a shaken heart toward purification, transferable recognition, and remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The report contains a chain of address: the Lord calls Moses, Moses is sent to speak, and Pharaoh gathers an audience, calls out, and states a rival claim. The outer question places the present addressee at the next link of this contested transmission.

activation_trace.role: Arrival turns the outer report into the latest movement in a relay of address.
Renewed speech and news provides the medium through which each call is carried onward.
A raised voice and call initiates the internal transmission that the outer report reenacts.
Voicing a statement makes Moses's commission an utterance that must be delivered.
Driving and gathering a group creates the public audience before which counter-speech is staged.
The raised public call repeats the form of calling while reversing its source and purpose.
The spoken rival claim makes the episode a contest over which voice will keep circulating.

structural_cues: The frame's second-person question is followed immediately by a divine call, then commanded speech, then a gathered public proclamation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a nested sequence of calls, sayings, and an audience; I infer that the outer question recruits its addressee into the same relay, while a live alternative treats the question as a conventional narrative frame only.

changed_reading.before: A report arrives as content for private reception.
changed_reading.after: A contested call arrives for relay: receiving Moses's report places the addressee inside an ongoing struggle between transmitted voices.

context_deltas.mechanism: Key motions leave the named episode and recur in generic human categories: Pharaoh transgresses and strives, while later whoever transgresses is contrasted with whoever fears, and each human remembers what was striven for. This recurrence converts Moses's story into a reusable diagnostic pattern.

activation_trace.role: Becoming an oft-told example permits the named episode to function beyond its original actors.
Crossing the limit in disobedience first marks Pharaoh's defining motion.
Fear joined with awe states the alternative response offered within the episode.
Work and purposive activity marks Pharaoh's enacted response rather than a merely verbal refusal.
The same work and acquisition becomes what every human later recalls, generalizing the earlier action.
Limit-crossing reappears without Pharaoh's name and turns his conduct into a general class.
Awe-filled fear reappears as the trait of the warning's receptive audience.

structural_cues: Vocabulary first attached to Pharaoh and his proposed alternative migrates into generic 'the human,' 'whoever transgressed,' and 'whoever fears.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated roots across the named episode and generic judgment scenes; I infer that the recurrence maps Pharaoh's choice onto every addressee, while a live alternative is simple thematic echo without full typological transfer.

changed_reading.before: Moses is a memorable example from another time.
changed_reading.after: Moses's report is a diagnostic template in which each present receiver's striving, transgression, or fear can be located.

context_deltas.mechanism: The report comes to the addressee near the opening of the narrative block, while the overwhelming event later comes inescapably. Focus branches join arrival to affliction and event-language to calamity, so the first coming can function as an advance, verbal arrival of the second.

activation_trace.role: The coming of affliction, destruction, or loss gives the report's arrival an ominous edge.
A temporal calamity within event-language lets the report bear the pressure of what it warns about.
Literal coming and obtaining echoes the focus arrival at the advent of the overwhelming event.
Compulsion and being driven leaves no distance from the later event, contrasting with voluntary reception of its advance report.

structural_cues: أَتَىٰكَ at 79:15 and جَآءَتِ at 79:34 place two acts of coming at the openings of the Moses account and the final overwhelming scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two arrival constructions plus focus branches of affliction and calamity; I infer that hearing the report is a voluntary anticipatory encounter with what will later arrive coercively, while a live alternative is only a lexical echo between unrelated arrivals.

changed_reading.before: A past calamity is delivered as news.
changed_reading.after: The delivered report is an advance arrival of calamity, giving the addressee a receptive encounter before unavoidable encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressee questioned about whether a report has reached him is later questioned by others about the Hour, located relative to its reminder, and restricted to warning those who fear it. Reception of the Moses report thus establishes a role rather than granting exhaustive information.

activation_trace.role: Arrival to the second-person receiver begins the transfer from being addressed to addressing others.
Renewable news is the communicative material the addressee can carry forward without possessing the Hour's endpoint.
Question and request reverse the direction of address as others now seek information from the one first questioned.
A reminder that makes one remember defines the addressee's proper relation to the Hour as admonitory rather than exhaustive.
Warning that awakens caution states the outward function produced by receiving the report.

structural_cues: The second-person suffix in أَتَىٰكَ is answered by يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ and repeated أَنتَ near the close; 79:44 assigns the endpoint to the Lord before 79:45 limits the addressee to warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored questioning, persistent second-person address, reminder, and warning; I infer a role handoff from receiver to warner, while a live alternative is rhetorical cohesion without an implied transmission sequence.

changed_reading.before: The question checks whether the addressee has received a piece of knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The question installs the addressee as a responsible receiver and relayer of warning, not as possessor of every requested detail.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a specialized ر س و branch about securing a report into literal fixing and mooring contexts. It remains anchored in focus حَدِيثُ and an explicit packet branch that names الحديث, but downstream prose should present it as a lexical-material analogy, not as a claim that حَدِيثُ syntactically means an anchorage.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حَدِيثُ is the exact noun named by the specialized report-securing branch under ر س و.

activation_trace.role: Renewed report-speech supplies the discourse object that can be imagined as given a stable edge.
Fixity and rooted stability provide the physical pole of the mooring analogy.
Securing a report and mentioning one of its edges links the question of mooring to a bounded, sufficient narrative disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The verse announces an undifferentiated story about Moses.
changed_reading.after: The verse may offer a deliberately moored edge of the Moses report: a stable narrative segment sufficient for orientation even while the Hour's own mooring remains unavailable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain reading built from watercourse and foreign-flood branches of focus ء ت ي, then activated by the valley and conveyed water in context. It remains anchored in أَتَىٰكَ as a mode of arrival, but downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for transmission rather than literal hydrology or a recovered lexical definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَتَىٰكَ can activate branches of a directed watercourse and a flood arriving from another land.

activation_trace.role: A watercourse whose path is opened models the report as directed flow toward the addressee.
A flood arriving from a rain-struck land into another models narrative force imported from a remote scene.
The valley as a flood channel gives the Moses scene a conduit image immediately after the focus verse.
Conveying water by pouring or irrigation reinforces directed transfer from source to recipient.

changed_reading.before: The report reaches the addressee by an unspecified act of communication.
changed_reading.after: The report is imaginatively channeled from the remote valley into the addressee like an influx, carrying the originating event's force into otherwise untouched ground.

strongest_changes: The focus question becomes a relay of contested calls rather than a private request for story knowledge.
Repeated roots move Pharaoh's transgression, striving, and offered fear into generic human categories, making the report a present diagnostic template.
Heart, purification, lesson, and remembrance turn the report's polishing branch into a coherent inward process.
The final questions revise reception into a bounded warning-role rather than possession of the Hour's endpoint.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the tiny arrival-question function simultaneously as transmission, reenacted event, inward instrument, typological mirror, and advance warning; the mooring and water-channel branches preserved two material analogies that a conservative synthesis would likely drop.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal link from report to heart-purification is reader-supplied even though every stage is packet-backed.
The advance-arrival relation between the Moses report and the overwhelming event may be a lexical echo rather than deliberate anticipation.
The mooring and watercourse readings are valid branch activations but remain form-distant and should not displace the communicative reading.
